name: duke
html:
Early August

  • Common Application made available

November 2

  • Application for Early Decision
  • Early Decision Agreement
  • High School Transcript
  • First Quarter Grades (submit via Optional Report; will accept through November 20 or when your first term ends)
  • Secondary School Report with Counselor Recommendation
  • Two Teacher Recommendations
  • SAT and/or ACT Scores (optional, last day to take standardized tests is November 7 for SAT; October 17 for ACT)
  • Arts Supplement (optional)
  • Financial Aid Applications
    • CSS Profile
    • FAFSA

November 9

  • Glimpse Interviews (optional)

November 15

  • Additional Financial Aid Documents (like your taxes)

Mid-December

  • Decisions released

Early August

  • Common Application made available

January 4

  • Application for Regular Decision
  • High School Transcript
  • Secondary School Report with Counselor Recommendation
  • Two Teacher Recommendations
  • SAT and/or ACT Scores (optional, last day to take standardized tests is December 5 for SAT; December 12 for ACT)
  • Arts Supplement (optional)

January 11

  • Glimpse Interviews (optional)

February 1

  • Financial Aid Applications
    • CSS Profile
    • FAFSA

February 15

  • Midyear Grade Report (or as soon as first marking period grades are available)

Late March/Early April

  • Decisions released

name: stanford
html:
Restrictive Early Action

Application with Optional Arts Portfolio - October 15
  • Common Application Deadline: October 15
  • Arts Portfolio Materials Deadline: October 20
  • Notification of Missing Documents: by mid-November
  • Decision Released: by mid-December
  • Student Reply Date: May 1

Please note: If you intend to submit an REA application with an Optional Arts Portfolio, you must submit the Common Application by October 15. Your transcript(s), School Report, and teacher/counselor letters of recommendation can be submitted by November 1.

Standard Application Deadline - November 1
  • Common Application Deadline: November 1
  • Notification of Missing Documents: by mid-November
  • Decision Released: by mid-December
  • Student Reply Date: May 1

Regular Decision

Application with Optional Arts Portfolio - December 5
  • Common Application Deadline: December 5
  • Arts Portfolio Materials Deadline: December 10
  • Notification of Missing Documents: by mid-February
  • Decision Released: by early April
  • Student Reply Date: May 1

Please note: If you intend to submit an RD application with an Optional Arts Portfolio, you must submit the Common Application by December 5. Your transcript(s), School Report, and teacher/counselor letters of recommendation can be submitted by January 5.

Standard Application Deadline - January 5
  • Common Application Deadline: January 5
  • Notification of Missing Documents: by mid-February
  • Decision Released: by early April
  • Student Reply Date: May 1
